ops.oldText: 7.2 Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: 7.2 Vendor is a non-exclusive provider of the Services. Customer may engage any other provider at any time, without notice to Vendor and without any obligation to disclose or match any other offer.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the requirement to disclose and match third-party offers before engaging another provider, as it operates as an open-ended exclusivity/right of first refusal on our sourcing and contradicts Section 12.3, under which we make no exclusivity commitment. Our playbook position is that Vendor is non-exclusive; if some restraint is needed we could consider one limited to a defined service category for 12 months, ending automatically on any service-level or delivery failure.
input.summary: Replace the match-before-sourcing obligation with express non-exclusivity.
